scoring.medicalUsefulness: 0-5: educational mechanisms most likely to need an accurate reusable visual
scoring.combinability: 0-5: useful with independent parts and attachment points
scoring.videoValue: 0-5: meaningful time-driven motion rather than a static icon
scoring.total: sum of the four scores; ties prefer higher combinability, then reuse frequency

selectionWorkflow: Record the starting component IDs from parts/catalog.json.
Search both parts/catalog.json and every scene/template source for an existing equivalent.
Score only nonduplicate candidates with the four named dimensions.
Choose the highest-scoring coherent gap and record dependencies, alternatives and rationale.
After implementation compute final IDs minus starting IDs and require exactly N for an explicit add-N request.
Run parts_verify and review bounds, parameter changes, themes, deterministic frames and standalone dependencies.
